metadata.page_title: Two Buck Luck vs Love(land) Hurts matchup report

summary.decision_summary: Two Buck Luck won by 0.8. Two Buck Luck left 4.5 lineup points on the table, while Love(land) Hurts left 8.6.
summary.historical_summary: Two Buck Luck is 18-14 against Love(land) Hurts across 32 meetings between these managers.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Love(land) Hurts
summary.winner_reason: Two Buck Luck won by 0.8, led by a 19.8-point edge at RB. The leading starters were Brock Purdy (33.6) and Amon-Ra St. Brown (33.2).
summary.loser_reason: Love(land) Hurts could not match the opponent's RB production, losing that position battle by 19.8 points. Colston Loveland scored 0.3. Its best legal lineup added 8.6, enough to put the lineup decisions directly in the result.
